data.narrative:
FuriosaAI is a Series C semiconductor company that has raised $246M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 3 public semiconductor firms (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) and 8 private peers in chips and semiconductors, including stage-adjacent companies Tenstorrent (Series D, $2.7B), Positron AI (Series B, $1.0B), and DEEPX (Series C, $529M).

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x multiplier typical of Series C to next-stage step-up transitions, using the $246M total raised as a proxy baseline, yielding $418M. Peer-median anchoring across the three same-sector comparables produces a $1.0B implied value, with the peer range spanning $529M to $2.7B. Public-comp pricing via price-to-sales cannot be applied because FuriosaAI's revenue is not disclosed, a standard constraint for private company analysis.

The two applicable methods triangulate to a range of $355M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $709M. The spread reflects material uncertainty around growth trajectory and capital efficiency relative to peers. Stage-progression anchors conservatively to historical capital deployment; peer-median places FuriosaAI closer to mid-range of the comparable set. Key uncertainties include competitive positioning within the frontier-chip landscape and near-term revenue generation capacity relative to public-market semiconductor multiples.
